settings.title: Runtime configuration status
settings.subtitle: Check whether services required by itinerary planning are configured in the deployment environment.
settings.securityDetail: Configuration status is read-only and secrets are never echoed back. Updating the Xiaohongshu cookie requires the admin token typed below; the token is never stored in the browser.
settings.loadFailedDetail: Confirm that the backend is reachable, then try again.
settings.providerGuide: Ask the deployment administrator to configure this provider in backend environment variables and restart the service. Never enter keys in the browser.
settings.noProviders: The backend did not return an available LLM provider.
settings.relaySubtitle: Connect one OpenAI-compatible relay and switch between DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, and more
settings.relayApiKeyHelp: The key is sent to the backend only and stored in server runtime settings — never in the browser. Leave it blank when saving to keep the key already stored.
settings.relayModelPlaceholder: Enter the URL and key, fetch models, then choose one
settings.relayFetched: Fetched {{count}} models, {{chat}} of them can chat
settings.relayModelHint: Only chat-capable models are listed; embedding / rerank / speech / image models are hidden
settings.relayModelEmpty: No models yet — click "Fetch models" first
settings.relayModelNeedFetch: No model list yet: enter the URL and key, click "Fetch models", then you can switch here
settings.relayFetchEmpty: No models returned. Check the URL and key.
settings.relaySaved: Saved. New plans will use this relay model.
settings.relayNeedBaseUrl: Enter the relay base URL first
settings.relayInactive: No relay configured yet. Configure one to switch models right here.
settings.relayAdminTokenHint: This is the SETTINGS_ADMIN_TOKEN you started the backend with — not the relay API key
settings.relayBaseUrlHint: Use the API base URL, not the console URL: SiliconFlow is https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1
settings.relaySecretDisabled: Secret writes are disabled on the backend, so saving will be rejected (403). Restart the backend with SETTINGS_ALLOW_SECRET_UPDATES=true and SETTINGS_ADMIN_TOKEN=<your own passphrase>, then enter that passphrase as the admin token.
settings.amapMapsDetail: Domestic POI, routing, and geocoding. The itinerary map and attraction images depend on it.
settings.amapMapsGuide: Set the server key as AMAP_API_KEY in the backend; the in-browser map also needs VITE_AMAP_WEB_JS_KEY and VITE_AMAP_SECURITY_JS_CODE, with the domain allowlisted in the AMap console.
settings.tencentMapsDetail: Domestic POI, routing, and geocoding data.
settings.tencentMapsGuide: Apply for a server key in Tencent Location Service, configure it in the backend environment, and set an allowlist.
settings.googleMapsDetail: International POI, routing, and place data. Data uses the server key; the basemap uses a separate browser key.
settings.googleMapsGuide: Data: enable Places / Geocoding / Directions in Google Cloud Console and set the server key as GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY (IP restricted). Basemap: create a separate browser key restricted by HTTP referrer and set VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY in the frontend.
settings.mapProviderSubtitle: Applies to this browser only — the itinerary map switches as soon as you pick.
settings.mapProviderAmapReady: VITE_AMAP_WEB_JS_KEY is set, ready to use.
settings.mapProviderGoogleReady: VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY is set, ready to use.
settings.mapProviderAmapMissing: VITE_AMAP_WEB_JS_KEY is missing, so selecting this only shows a setup hint.
settings.mapProviderGoogleMissing: VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY is missing, so selecting this only shows a setup hint.
settings.mapProviderTencentNote: Tencent Maps is used server-side only (POI, routing, geocoding) and has no browser basemap, so it is not listed here.
settings.mapProviderDataNote: This only changes who draws the basemap. Which provider supplies POIs and routes is decided by the backend GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY / Tencent key.
settings.xhsDetail: With the cookie configured, Xiaohongshu photos become an image source: attractions missing from official galleries get real photos, marked "XHS photo" on the card.
settings.xhsGuide: Complete server-side configuration under the data-source authorization policy. The browser stores no cookies, tokens, or account credentials.
settings.configuredHelp: The service is ready for backend use.
settings.unconfiguredHelp: Complete the guide below, then refresh this page to recheck.
settings.xhsPanelSubtitle: Paste the Cookie header from your browser, validate it, then save. It takes effect immediately and is used for attraction research.
settings.xhsAdminTokenHelp: The token comes from settings.allow-secret-updates=true and settings.admin-token. It is used for this request only and is not stored in the browser.
settings.xhsCookieRequired: Please paste the Xiaohongshu cookie first
settings.xhsRequestFailed: Request failed, please check if the backend is reachable

tripMap.missingKeyTitle: AMap Web JS Key is not configured
tripMap.missingKeyDetail: Set VITE_AMAP_WEB_JS_KEY in your local .env. The rest of the itinerary remains available.
tripMap.noCoordinatesTitle: This itinerary has no usable attraction coordinates
tripMap.noCoordinatesDetail: Add attraction coordinates to generate markers and routes automatically.
tripMap.loadErrorTitle: The map service is temporarily unavailable
tripMap.loadErrorDetail: Check your network, Key domain allowlist, and security code, then refresh.
tripMap.securityCodeMissing: AMap security code is not active
tripMap.securityCodeMissingTitle: The AMap security code is not active, so the map cannot render
tripMap.securityCodeMissingDetail: Set VITE_AMAP_SECURITY_JS_CODE in your local .env and make sure the window._AMapSecurityConfig injection in frontend/index.html is still present, then restart the dev server or rebuild.
tripMap.googleMissingKeyTitle: Google Maps Web JS Key is not configured
tripMap.googleMissingKeyDetail: Set VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY in your local .env and allowlist this domain as an HTTP referrer in Google Cloud Console, then restart the dev server or rebuild.
tripMap.googleLoadErrorDetail: Check your network (maps.googleapis.com is usually unreachable from mainland China), the key's HTTP referrer allowlist, and that Maps JavaScript API is enabled, then refresh.
